feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 21 May 2026 11:28am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 21 May 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure area is slow-moving to the west of Ireland, with a moist southerly air stream becoming established in the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 early afternoon, backing south or southeast 3 or 4 for a time this evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming slight or moderate this evening.


##Weather##

Patchy light rain and drizzle in the afternoon. Areas of mist and isolated fog patches during the afternoon and again tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in rain, drizzle or mist, and very poor in fog.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 Friday evening, then 2 or 3 in the southeast of the area Saturday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight Friday evening, then smooth in the southeast of the area Saturday morning.


##Weather##

Continuing risk of mist and fog patches tomorrow afternoon and Saturday morning.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor or very poor in mist and fog patches.
